acceptanceCriteria: TestDogfoodEventReadOnlyEnrolledStopAndPrompt/LCP-V0-001_authority (cmd/corvint/local_completion_event_test.go:545) runs with a context that carries the gokernel.WithProbeBound test seam from V1-1391 (or an equivalent event-ordered wait), so the fixed 10 s Git probe bound cannot expire first under host load.

Under 64 CPU burners, base vs fixed failure counts are recorded and the fixed test has 0 failures; one mutation (seam not applied) brings back the 'Git repository probe exceeded its 10-second deadline' failure.
body: Residual from V1-1391 (PR #912). Under contention (load 133-180), the ReadOnly LCP-V0-001 authority subtest failed once with 'Git repository probe exceeded its 10-second deadline'. It is the same class as the lifecycle 'first Stop did not block' failure fixed in V1-1391, but the test calls gokernel.HandleEvent without a ctx, so it cannot carry the probe-bound seam. Product Stop fail-open under load stays with V1-1120. Depends on #912 landing for the seam.
title: LCP-V0-001 ReadOnly authority test misses the probe-bound seam and fails under host load
